tagline.en: Microsoft's interactive Minecraft world model — steer an autoregressive video simulator with game actions.
tagline.zh: 微软的交互式 Minecraft 世界模型——用游戏动作驱动一个自回归视频模拟器。

en: MineWorld is an interactive world model from Microsoft, built around the game of Minecraft. Rather than generating a fixed clip, it simulates the world frame by frame in response to player actions, so you can move, look, and act and watch the scene evolve accordingly.

It belongs to the family of action-conditioned video world models: given a starting view and a stream of interaction tokens, it autoregressively predicts what the world looks like next. This makes it a testbed for embodied agents and for studying how a learned model captures game dynamics.

In WorldFoundry you drive MineWorld through the shared world-model interface — supply an initial context and a sequence of actions, and it rolls out the resulting video. Model weights and the accompanying validation assets are obtained separately before you run it.
zh: MineWorld 是微软推出的交互式世界模型，以 Minecraft 游戏为载体。它不是生成一段固定的片段，而是根据玩家动作逐帧模拟世界，你可以移动、转视角、执行操作，画面会随之演化。
它属于动作条件视频世界模型这一类方法：给定一个起始画面和一串交互动作，它以自回归方式预测世界的下一帧。这让它成为研究具身智能体、以及考察模型如何习得游戏动态的试验场。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一的世界模型接口来驱动 MineWorld——给出初始上下文和一串动作，它就会推演出对应的视频。运行前需要单独获取模型权重和配套的数据资源。

whenToUse.en: Reach for MineWorld when you want an interactive, action-controllable simulator of a Minecraft-style environment — for prototyping embodied agents or exploring how a world model responds to player input.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个可交互、可用动作控制的 Minecraft 风格环境模拟器时，可以选择 MineWorld——适合搭建具身智能体原型，或探索世界模型如何回应玩家输入。

notFor.en: Not a general text-to-video tool; it is tied to the Minecraft domain and expects action inputs. Weights and validation data are downloaded separately rather than bundled.
notFor.zh: 它不是通用的文生视频工具，而是绑定在 Minecraft 领域、需要动作输入。权重与验证数据需单独下载，并非随附。

en: Interactive, action-conditioned world model for Minecraft
Autoregressive frame-by-frame rollout driven by player actions
From Microsoft, with source and paper openly available
zh: 面向 Minecraft 的交互式、动作条件世界模型
由玩家动作驱动、逐帧自回归推演
来自微软，源码与论文公开可查
适配 WorldFoundry 统一的世界模型接口
